title: COMP 4736 · Midterm
subtitle: Exam week Oct 26–30: closed book, LockDown Browser; Part 1 T/F and MCQ, Part 2 written; lecture Parts 1 to 5
description: The instructor's practice midterm, worked: all 74 Part 1 questions grouped by lecture Part with explanations that teach the slide fact behind each one, the five written questions (pipeline rate and delay, CPU utilization from a job timeline with and without multiprogramming, 1 − pⁿ with a RAM budget, two parallel jobs with 50 % I/O wait, a direct-mapped cache trace) asked for your number first and then worked step by step, a mock Part 1 and a mock Part 2 in the real format with new questions, and the closed-book recall drill across all five Parts.
intro:
:::quiz Midterm facts
**Exam week Oct 26–30 2026, no classes; check the Learning Hub for your slot.** Two parts: **Part 1** T/F and MCQ in **LockDown Browser** on your own laptop (fully charged); **Part 2** written, on paper or online. **Closed book: no cell phone, no cheat sheet, no lecture notes, no book.** Bring blank paper, a calculator (LockDown Browser has one) and your student ID. No makeup exam. Topics: Part 1 Introduction, Part 2 OS Structures and Clocks, Part 3 Processes, Part 4 Threads, Part 5 System Calls. The posted practice (Quizzes → Midterm_Practice_Part_1, 74 marks) weighs Part 1 at 42 of 74; the written practice is five calculations.
:::
